name: 35657-imageprompt-nemotron12b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: NemotronH_Nano_VL_V2: a nemotron_h hybrid language side (Mamba-2, attention and MLP blocks, hidden 5120) with a C-RADIOv2-H vision tower at patch 16; 13.18 B parameters, BF16 throughout (26.4 GB of weights), trust_remote_code. All shapes are read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 4, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 512 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, seed static 35657. On a request bound the warmup drops 128 and the cooldown is inert, so ~384 requests fall inside the measured window.
workload: single-turn photo prompting: one 3024x4032 photograph and a 32-token instruction in, 8 tokens out, a different photograph every request. Synthesised by guidellm from two --data sources, because synthetic_image emits only an image column: synthetic_text with prompt_tokens 32 and output_tokens 8, each pinned min == max (output_tokens is declared on that source ONLY -- it sums across sources); synthetic_image at 3024x4032, images_per_request 1, format jpeg, jpeg_quality 85, content solid. Per request on the wire: 248.9 KiB of base64 JPEG and 32 text tokens in, 8 tokens out.
purpose: A photo captioning assistant taking one full-size photograph and a brief instruction per request, four users at once, one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.17.0rc1.dev, a source checkout of commit 40077ea3defdf2b0997245ca8999097eede2308f: no
# released wheel is this tree. `configs/env.yaml` says where its interpreter lives on this
# machine. The load is not in this file -- it is scenario.json's `streams`.

model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-VL-BF16

# Required by the checkpoint: its config carries an `auto_map` onto model code that ships in the
# repository, and the architecture will not load without it.
trust_remote_code: true

dtype: bfloat16

tensor_parallel_size: 1
pipeline_parallel_size: 1

# INLINE JSON, NOT A BLOCK MAPPING: this file is read with a flat line reader that skips every
# indented line, so a block-style value is dropped whole and the engine would start without this
# argument at rc=0.
limit_mm_per_prompt: {"image": 1}

max_model_len: 8192
max_num_seqs: 16
gpu_memory_utilization: 0.9
seed: 35657
